honesty_boundary: This is a finite detector-bin incidence synthesis. It does not calibrate detector efficiency, dark counts, timing jitter, or physical chip loss.
interpretation: BT1602 makes the 168 active detector bins structural: five Fano lines carry the five Witting fuel gates, and the two remaining Fano lines carry compatible controls. The same-ray controls anchor one gate-line bin per Witting source.

synthesis_identity.active_bins: 168 = 7 Fano lines * 3 points per line * 8 D4 source states = 7*24
synthesis_identity.compatible_shell: 12 compatible off-diagonal targets = 2 reserve Fano lines * 3 point slots * 2 detector parities
synthesis_identity.fuel_shell: 27 incompatible targets = 3 Fano point slots * 9 Hesse/OAM residues
synthesis_identity.same_ray: one same-ray control anchors the source gate-line bin

title: Fano/Witting active detector-bin synthesis
